'''Weitun''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Sriluur (star)|Sriluur]] in the [[Sriluur system/Legends|Sriluur system]],<ref name="GW" /> located in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Weitun was a [[Temperature/Legends|searing]] rock without any [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="GW" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Sriluur system/Legends|Sriluur system]], except [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]], were designed for the [[2004]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Sriluur star system in grid square S-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
